reserveReview.rationale: On-chain capture at IOTA checkpoint 209253976 (2026-10-27T08:50:19.027Z) read all four live shared Virtue vaults (each at object version 865864435). Vault balances were 2,410.072442864 IOTA, 6,769,320.654962283 stIOTA, 3,000.02764228 vIOTA, and 0.0149549784 iBTC. NativePool and cert::Metadata objects at checkpoint 209253974 imply exchange rates of 1.1733423906 IOTA/stIOTA and 1.0771251052 IOTA/vIOTA, computed as (total_staked + total_rewards - collected_rewards) / cert total_supply and consistent with the rates realized in the latest on-chain stake and unstake events. CoinGecko spot values observed at 2026-10-27T08:50Z were $0.04190442 IOTA/USD and $79,722 BTC/USD. The resulting collateral values were approximately $100.99, $332,835.53, $135.41, and $1,192.24, normalized to 0.03%, 99.57%, 0.04%, and 0.36% (100.00% total). The stIOTA vault balance fell from 8,950,007.8 stIOTA at the 2026-09-21 capture. The composition is fully identified at the capture point; no independent reserve attestation or legal custody assurance is published.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current on-chain branch balances and NativePool exchange rates read at IOTA checkpoint 209253976, valued with contemporaneous IOTA/USD and BTC/USD spot prices and cross-checked against Virtue's CDP collateral documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified direct collateral or tracked-stablecoin dependency remains at the 2026-10-27 checkpoint capture; all four slices are external cryptoasset identities rather than Pharos-tracked stablecoins. Independent reserve assurance, legal segregation, and guaranteed liquidation liquidity are not disclosed and are recorded in custodyProfile rather than as an unidentified composition slice.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-09-21 capture shows collateral in four shared protocol vault objects, so on-chain custody remains omnibus at the protocol and branch level rather than an identified bank or segregated account. The package is immutable but an AdminCap gates supply limits and module versions, and liquidations run through a configured executor. No independent reserve attestation, legal segregation statement, bankruptcy-remoteness opinion, rehypothecation policy, or other assurance report covering the current collateral was found in the reviewed issuer documentation or on-chain sources.
